question: **Choose the incorrectly spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is: "**Friying**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct spelling of the word is "**Frying**".
 
• "**Frying**" means cooking food in hot oil or fat. (गर्म तेल या वसा में खाना पकाना)
 
• Incorrect spelling of words can lead to miscommunication and confusion.&
